growth.sentenceEn: As the streamers' emphasis changed from subscriber growth to profitability, prices for the services went up and the number of new shows went down to 481 released in 2023, with the number expected to dip into the 300s within a few years.

growth.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

growth.sentenceEn: Prior to forming a growth team, the software company BitTorrent had 50 employees working in the traditional departments of engineering, marketing and product development.
growth.translationZh: 在组建增长团队之前，软件公司BitTorrent有50名员工，分别在工程、营销和产品开发等传统部门工作。
growth.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

growth.sentenceEn: A growth team is made up of members from different departments within your company, and it harnesses the power of collaboration to focus exclusively on finding ways to grow.
growth.translationZh: 增长团队由公司内部不同部门的成员组成，它借助协作的力量，专门致力于寻找增长途径。
growth.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

growth.sentenceEn: The growth leader is also responsible for keeping the team focused on moving forward and steering them clear of distractions.
growth.translationZh: 增长团队领导者还负责保持团队专注于前进方向，并引导他们避开干扰。
growth.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

growth.sentenceEn: Things changed, however, when an innovative project-marketing manager came aboard, created a growth team and sparked the kind of fresh perspective they needed.
growth.translationZh: 然而，当一位富有创新精神的项目营销经理加入公司，组建了增长团队，并带来了他们所需的全新视角后，情况发生了改变。
growth.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

growth.sentenceEn: It hinders the growth of "international" journals.
growth.translationZh: 这阻碍了“国际”期刊的发展。

generation.sentenceEn: "Insects that today are a minor problem may become a major problem if they can produce three or four generations in a year," says forest ecologist John Stanturf.

generation.sentenceEn: So if we are to protect our libraries for future generations , we must raise awareness of them and the work they do.

generation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

generation.sentenceEn: There is no good reason that these artifacts should be beyond the ordinary reach of the educational objectives or inspiration of the generations to which they were left.
generation.translationZh: 没有充分理由让这些文物脱离其本应传承给的后代子孙的教育目标或灵感启迪的寻常可达范围。

generation.sentenceEn: And he's become a sudden hit in the new world of text-to-image AI generation .

generation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

generation.sentenceEn: What can be concluded about Generation Z from the last two paragraphs?

gap.sentenceEn: There's also a knowledge gap that needs to be addressed — 40% of individuals surveyed are unsure about who retains ownership over the content produced by AI.

gap.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

gap.sentenceEn: Between friends, longer gaps seem to provide natural moments for reflection and expression.
gap.translationZh: 在朋友之间，较长时间的间隔似乎能自然地提供反思和表达的契机。
gap.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

gap.sentenceEn: Long gaps between strangers are likely to be followed by a change in topic.

gap.sentenceEn: During conversations with short gaps , people feel more connected to their conversation partners.
gap.translationZh: 在对话中有短暂间隔时，人们会感觉与交谈对象的联系更紧密。

gap.sentenceEn: But such feelings of connection markedly dip when entering a long gap .

global.sentenceEn: Asia is arguably the region most neglected by global efforts to increase diversity in restoration and to study native species.

global.sentenceEn: Much of the global funding for restoration is dedicated to developing it as a tool to mitigate climate change, notes restoration ecologist Pedro Brancalion.
global.translationZh: 修复生态学家佩德罗·布兰卡里昂指出，全球大部分用于修复工作的资金都致力于将其作为减缓气候变化的工具。
global.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

global.sentenceEn: But now piracy involving illegal streaming services as well as file-sharing costs the US economy about $30 billion in lost revenue a year and some 250,000 jobs, estimates the US Chamber of Commerce's Global Innovation Policy Center.

global.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

global.sentenceEn: Global heating is benefiting some species but others are too isolated to find suitable new habitat, and gardening habits—paving over gardens and using pesticides—aren't helping either.

global.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

global.translationZh: 解决之道在于改变学术界的思维模式，以及其对自身主要目标的定位。全球性挑战和社会创新理应得到科学家们，尤其是青年科学家们更多的关注。

gain.sentenceEn: The situation presents a delicate balance between leveraging AI for its productivity gains and risking confidential data exposure.

gain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

gain.sentenceEn: It gains Microsoft broad rights to the data inputted or outputted by any user — rights to use this data in any way it sees fit; it can even share it with third parties.
gain.translationZh: 这使微软获得了用户输入或输出数据的广泛权利——微软有权以其认为合适的任何方式使用这些数据，甚至可以将其与第三方共享。
gain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

gain.sentenceEn: To gain buy-in on an innovative, new idea, follow these steps:
gain.translationZh: 要让人们接受一个创新的新想法，请遵循以下步骤：

gain.translationZh: 获得认同的最大障碍之一是，当想法提出者被视为好辩、爱辩解或思想封闭时。

gain.sentenceEn: "Whatever we mean by the economy growing, by things getting better, the gains will have to be more evenly shared than in the recent past," she writes.

gain.sentenceEn: radio listeners could make unexpected gains .

generally.translationZh: 研究结果显示，求助者通常会低估他人提供帮助的意愿，以及这会给帮助者带来的愉悦感（对大多数人来说，有机会帮助他人是一件非常有意义的事情）。

generally.translationZh: 它在青年时期达到顶峰，保持一段时间稳定水平，然后通常会随着年龄增长开始缓慢下降。

generally.sentenceEn: The art market generally went downward in various ways.

graduate.sentenceEn: Employers have long seen the advantages of hiring school leavers who often prove themselves to be more committed and loyal employees than graduates .
graduate.translationZh: 雇主们早就意识到招聘中学毕业生的优势，这些毕业生往往证明自己比大学毕业生更敬业、更忠诚。

graduate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

graduate.sentenceEn: He found a dream job after graduating from college.

giant.sentenceEn: The Dutch giant Elsevier, which claims to publish 25% of the scientific papers produced in the world, made profits of more than £900m last year, while UK universities alone spent more than £210m in 2016 to enable researchers to access their own publicly funded research; both figures seem to rise unstoppably despite increasingly desperate efforts to change them.

giant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

giant.sentenceEn: He quotes a giant of classical economics, Alfred Marshall, in describing this financial impatience as acting like "children who pick the plums out of their pudding to eat them at once" rather than putting them aside to be eaten last.
giant.translationZh: 他引用古典经济学巨匠阿尔弗雷德·马歇尔的话，将这种金融上的急躁行为描述为像“孩子们把布丁里的梅子挑出来立刻吃掉”，而不是把它们留到最后再吃。

gender.sentenceEn: Requiring companies to make gender the primary qualification for board membership will inevitably lead to less experienced private sector boards.

gender.translationZh: 挪威在全国范围内实行企业性别配额制度后，就恰好发生了这种情况。

gender.sentenceEn: A pair of bills sponsored by Massachusetts state Senator Jason Lewis and House Speaker Pro Tempore Patricia Haddad, to ensure " gender parity" on boards and commissions, provides a case in point.
gender.translationZh: 马萨诸塞州参议员杰森·刘易斯和众议院临时议长帕特里夏·哈达德提出的两项法案旨在确保各委员会和董事会实现"性别平等"，这就是一个恰当的例子。
gender.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

gender.sentenceEn: The bills are similar to a measure recently adopted in California, which last year became the first state to require gender quotas for private companies.
gender.translationZh: 这些法案与加州最近通过的一项措施类似，加州去年成为首个要求私营公司实行性别配额的州。
gender.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

gender.sentenceEn: Next time somebody pushes corporate quotas as a way to promote gender equity, remember that such policies are largely self-serving measures that make their sponsors feel good but do little to help average women.

gender.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

gender.sentenceEn: Factors such as the place and period in which we are reading, our gender , ethnicity, age and social class will encourage us towards certain interpretations but at the same time obscure or even close off others.

generate.translationZh: 当时，Netflix、亚马逊和 Apple TV 等平台投入了数十亿美元来制作内容以吸引新订阅者，导致当年发布的剧本剧集达到了 633 部。

generate.sentenceEn: At the same time AI can also be used to generate content for social media posts and chat sites.
generate.translationZh: 同时，人工智能还可用于为社交媒体帖子和聊天网站生成内容。

gene.sentenceEn: Why this similarity exists in smell genes is difficult to explain, for now.

gene.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

genetic.sentenceEn: Not only does understanding the equines' genetic makeup help reveal their contribution to human history, but it also might improve their management in the future, as climate change alters the planet's environment, write the authors.
genetic.translationZh: 作者写道，了解马科动物的基因构成不仅有助于揭示它们对人类历史的贡献，而且随着气候变化改变地球环境，这还可能改善未来对它们的管理。
genetic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

genetic.sentenceEn: Christopher Kettle, Biodiversity International's director for forest genetic resources and restoration in Rome, says that the need for infrastructure — things such as mechanisms for collecting and storing seeds, and nurseries to raise seedlings — might be most desperate here because many trees are 'masting' species, which don't produce seeds every year.
genetic.translationZh: 位于罗马的国际生物多样性中心森林遗传资源与修复主管克里斯托弗·凯特尔表示，这里对基础设施（如种子采集和储存机制，以及培育幼苗的苗圃）的需求最为迫切，因为许多树木属于“大年结实”物种，并不会每年都产种。
genetic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

genetic.sentenceEn: Last year a federal task-force urged reform for patents related to genetic tests.
genetic.translationZh: 去年，一个联邦特别工作组敦促对基因检测相关专利进行改革。
genetic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

genetic.sentenceEn: Critics make three main arguments against gene patents: a gene is a product of nature, so it may not be patented; gene patents suppress innovation rather than reward it; and patents' monopolies restrict access to genetic tests such as Myriad's.
genetic.translationZh: 批评者对基因专利提出了三个主要反对理由：基因是自然产物，因此不应被授予专利；基因专利会抑制而非奖励创新；专利垄断会限制人们获取像Myriad公司这样的基因检测服务。
genetic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

genetic.sentenceEn: Critics also argue that commercial genetic testing is only as good as the reference collections to which a sample is compared.
genetic.translationZh: 批评者还认为，商业基因检测的准确性取决于用于样本比对的参考数据库。
genetic.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
genetic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

genetic.sentenceEn: Genetic analysis offers insight into the history of donkeys.
genetic.translationZh: 基因分析为研究驴的历史提供了见解。

grant.sentenceEn: That March, President Ulysses S. Grant signed an act into law that established Yellowstone as the world's first national park.
grant.translationZh: 同年3月，尤利西斯·S·格兰特总统签署法案，正式将黄石确立为世界上第一个国家公园。

grant.sentenceEn: These unilateral developments differ in their specifics, but they are all designed to tax multinationals on income and revenue that countries believe they should have a right to tax, even if international tax rules do not grant them that right.
grant.translationZh: 这些单边举措在具体细节上各有不同，但它们的共同目的是对跨国公司的收入和营收征税。各国认为自己有权对此类收入征税，即便国际税收规则并未赋予它们这一权利。
grant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

grant.sentenceEn: Most of the first-generation students (59.1 percent) were recipients of Pell Grants , a federal grant for undergraduates with financial need, while this was true only for 8.6 percent of the students with at least one parent with a four-year degree.
grant.translationZh: 大多数第一代大学生（59.1%）获得了佩尔助学金——这是一项面向有经济需求的本科生的联邦助学金——而在父母中至少有一方拥有四年制大学学位的学生中，这一比例仅为8.6%。
grant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

grant.sentenceEn: When he feels down – say, after giving a bad lecture – he grants himself permission to be human.
grant.translationZh: 当他感到沮丧时——比如说，在讲了一堂糟糕的课后——他会允许自己展现人性的弱点。
grant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

grant.sentenceEn: While these measures would be welcome in the short term, we must face up to the fact that the existing £4.5bn programme of grants to fund new affordable housing, set to expire in 2015, is unlikely to be extended beyond then.
grant.translationZh: 虽然这些措施在短期内会受到欢迎，但我们必须正视这样一个事实：现有的45亿英镑经济适用房建设资助计划将于2015年到期，而且不太可能在此之后延期。
grant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

grant.sentenceEn: The housing sector needs to accept that we are very unlikely to ever return to the era of large-scale public grants .
grant.translationZh: 住房建设部门需要接受这样一个事实：我们极不可能回到大规模公共拨款的时代了。
grant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

growing.sentenceEn: Instead, a growing body of research showed that frequent, low-severity fires made many ecosystems healthier.
growing.translationZh: 相反，越来越多的研究表明，频繁且低烈度的火灾能让许多生态系统变得更加健康。
growing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

growing.sentenceEn: Branch points out that, even if a growing number of official guidelines and textbooks reflect scientific consensus on climate change, unofficial educational materials that convey more slanted perspectives are being distributed to teachers.
growing.translationZh: 布兰奇指出，即便越来越多的官方指南和教科书反映了气候变化方面的科学共识，但一些传达更具倾向性观点的非官方教育材料仍在向教师们传播。
growing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

growing.sentenceEn: But after the war, great social and political changes arising out of the successful war against Fascism created a growing demand in European and American economies for increasing numbers of graduates with more than a secondary school education.
growing.translationZh: 但战后，随着反法西斯战争的胜利，巨大的社会和政治变革应运而生，这使得欧美经济体对中学以上学历毕业生的需求日益增长。
growing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

growing.sentenceEn: Unlike so-called basic emotions such as sadness, fear, and anger, guilt emerges a little later, in conjunction with a child's growing grasp of social and moral norms.
growing.translationZh: 与悲伤、恐惧和愤怒等所谓的基本情绪不同，内疚感出现得稍晚一些，它伴随着孩子对社会规范和道德准则的理解逐渐加深而产生。
growing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

growing.sentenceEn: A growing number of researchers and organisations are now thinking seriously about that question.
growing.translationZh: 越来越多的研究人员和机构正在认真思考这个问题。
growing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

growing.sentenceEn: A growing number seem to agree.
growing.translationZh: 越来越多的人似乎认同这些观点。
growing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

guarantee.sentenceEn: A flashing set of healthy and clean, regular 'pearly whites' was a rare sight in Victorian society, the preserve of the super-rich (and even then, dental hygiene was not guaranteed ).
guarantee.translationZh: 在维多利亚时代的社会中，拥有一口健康洁净、整齐洁白的“珍珠皓齿”实属罕见，这是超级富豪的专属（即便如此，牙齿卫生也无法保证）。
guarantee.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

guarantee.sentenceEn: Because the California law applies to all boards, even where there is no history of prior discrimination, courts are likely to rule that the law violates the constitutional guarantee of "equal protection".
guarantee.translationZh: 由于加州这项法律适用于所有董事会，甚至包括那些从未有过歧视历史的董事会，法院很可能会裁定该法律违反了宪法保障的“平等保护”原则。
guarantee.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

guarantee.sentenceEn: Yet as we report now, the food police are determined that this enjoyment should be rendered yet another guilty pleasure guaranteed to damage our health.
guarantee.translationZh: 然而，正如我们现在所报道的，食品监管部门却决心要将这种享受也归为又一种必定损害健康的“罪恶快感”。
guarantee.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

guarantee.sentenceEn: Starting next year, any guaranteed bonus of top executives could be delayed 10 years if their banks are under investigation for wrongdoing.
guarantee.translationZh: 从明年开始，若银行因不当行为正在接受调查，高管的任何保障性奖金都可能被推迟10年发放。
guarantee.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

guarantee.sentenceEn: If it is trying to upset Google, which relies almost wholly on advertising, it has chosen an indirect method: there is no guarantee that DNT by default will become the norm.
guarantee.translationZh: 如果微软试图激怒几乎完全依赖广告业务的谷歌，那么它选择的方法并不直接：默认启用DNT功能能否成为行业标准，这一点毫无保证。
guarantee.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

guarantee.sentenceEn: Take measures to guarantee its quality.

guilt.sentenceEn: In the popular imagination, of course, guilt still gets a bad rap.
guilt.translationZh: 当然，在大众的印象中，内疚仍然名声不佳。
guilt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

guilt.sentenceEn: And vice versa: High sympathy can substitute for low guilt .
guilt.translationZh: 反之亦然：高共情能力可以弥补低愧疚感的不足。
guilt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

guilt.sentenceEn: Unlike so-called basic emotions such as sadness, fear, and anger, guilt emerges a little later, in conjunction with a child's growing grasp of social and moral norms.
guilt.translationZh: 与悲伤、恐惧和愤怒等所谓的基本情绪不同，内疚感出现得稍晚一些，它伴随着孩子对社会规范和道德准则的理解逐渐加深而产生。
guilt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

guilt.sentenceEn: Some kids who are low in sympathy may make up for that shortfall by experiencing more guilt , which can rein in their nastier impulses.
guilt.translationZh: 一些缺乏同情心的孩子可能会通过体验更多内疚感来弥补这一不足，这种内疚感可以抑制他们更恶劣的冲动。
guilt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

guilt.sentenceEn: This is why researchers generally regard so-called moral guilt , in the right amount, to be a good thing.
guilt.translationZh: 这就是为什么研究人员通常认为，适量的所谓道德内疚是一件好事。
guilt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

guilt.sentenceEn: Work by Tina Malti, a psychology professor at the University of Toronto, suggests that guilt may compensate for an emotional deficiency.
guilt.translationZh: 多伦多大学心理学教授蒂娜·马尔蒂的研究表明，内疚感可能会弥补某种情感缺陷。
guilt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

gambling.sentenceEn: In March 1998, a friend of Williams's got him involuntarily confined to a treatment center for addictions, and wrote to inform the casino of Williams's gambling problem.
gambling.translationZh: 1998年3月，威廉姆斯的一位朋友强行将他送进了戒瘾治疗中心，并写信告知赌场威廉姆斯的赌博问题。
gambling.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
gambling.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

gambling.sentenceEn: During several years of gambling in that casino, Williams, a state auditor earning $35,000 a year, lost approximately $175,000.
gambling.translationZh: 在那家赌场赌博的几年间，身为州审计员、年薪35,000美元的威廉姆斯输掉了大约175,000美元。
gambling.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
gambling.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

gambling.sentenceEn: Nevertheless, Williams's suit charges that the casino, knowing he was "helplessly addicted to gambling ," intentionally worked to "lure" him to "engage in conduct against his will." Well.
gambling.translationZh: 然而，威廉姆斯在诉讼中指控赌场明明知道他“无可救药地沉迷于赌博”，却故意“引诱”他“违背自己的意愿参与赌博”。好吧。
gambling.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
gambling.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

gambling.sentenceEn: And since the first Internet gambling site was created in 1995, competition for gamblers' dollars has become intense.
gambling.translationZh: 自从1995年第一个互联网赌博网站创建以来，争夺赌徒资金的竞争变得异常激烈。
gambling.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
gambling.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第2句

gambling.sentenceEn: The fourth edition of the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders says "pathological gambling " involves persistent, recurring and uncontrollable pursuit less of money than of the thrill of taking risks in quest of a windfall.
gambling.translationZh: 《精神疾病诊断与统计手册》第四版指出，“病态赌博”表现为一种持续、反复且无法控制的追求，追求的并非金钱本身，而是在冒险寻求意外之财过程中的刺激感。
gambling.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
gambling.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

gambling.sentenceEn: The anonymous, lonely, undistracted nature of online gambling is especially conducive to compulsive behavior. But even if the government knew how to move against Internet gambling , what would be its grounds for doing so?
gambling.translationZh: 在线赌博的匿名性、孤独感和不受干扰的特点，尤其容易滋生强迫性赌博行为。但即使政府知道如何打击网络赌博，这么做的理由又是什么呢？
gambling.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）

guide.sentenceEn: But understanding where the animals were first domesticated could guide archaeologists to a narrow region to search for insights about the original tamed donkeys.
guide.translationZh: 但了解这些动物最初是在哪里被驯化的，可以引导考古学家前往一个狭窄的区域，去寻找关于最初被驯服驴类的见解。
guide.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

guide.sentenceEn: HAPs could also guide efforts to retrofit homes or modify building regulations.
guide.translationZh: 高空平台系统还可以指导住宅翻新工作或修改建筑法规。
guide.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

guide.sentenceEn: New research suggests that smell is a crucial factor in guiding elephants—and probably other herbivores—to the best food resources.
guide.translationZh: 新研究表明，嗅觉是引导大象——很可能还有其他食草动物——找到最佳食物资源的关键因素。
guide.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

guide.sentenceEn: To filter out what is unique from what is shared might enable us to understand how complex cultural behavior arose and what guides it in evolutionary or cognitive terms.
guide.translationZh: 将文化中独特的部分与共有的部分区分开来，或许能让我们理解复杂的文化行为是如何产生的，以及在进化或认知层面是什么因素在引导这些行为。
guide.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

guide.sentenceEn: His biographies of James Watt, Richard Arkwright and Josiah Wedgwood were held up as beacons to guide the working man through his difficult life.
guide.translationZh: 他所撰写的詹姆斯·瓦特、理查德·阿克莱特和乔赛亚·韦奇伍德的传记被奉为灯塔，指引着劳动人民度过艰辛的人生。
guide.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

guide.sentenceEn: The rough guide to marketing success used to be that you got what you paid for.
guide.translationZh: 过去，市场营销成功的大致准则是一分钱一分货。
guide.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

gather.sentenceEn: In 1967 a scientific survey of the Peloponnesian coast was gathering data to analyze changes in sea levels when British oceanographer Nicholas Flemming first spotted the sunken structures.
gather.translationZh: 1967年，一项针对伯罗奔尼撒半岛海岸的科学调查正在收集数据以分析海平面变化，此时英国海洋学家尼古拉斯·弗莱明首次发现了这些沉没的建筑物。
gather.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

gather.sentenceEn: Data can be gathered on where the customer can be engaged, such as location, devices used, website interactions, and sites visited, to display marketing messages in appropriate forms, including emails, social media posts, pop-up advertisements, and banners at an appropriate frequency.
gather.translationZh: 可以收集有关客户互动渠道的数据，例如位置、使用的设备、网站交互和访问过的站点，以便以适当的形式（包括电子邮件、社交媒体帖子、弹窗广告和横幅）并按适当的频率展示营销信息。
gather.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

gather.translationZh: 这两份请愿书分别收集到了7,276个和11,282个签名。
gather.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

gather.sentenceEn: In response to another petition last year about banning fake lawns, which gathered 30,000 signatures, the government responded that it has "no plans to ban the use of artificial grass".
gather.translationZh: 去年有一份呼吁禁止人造草坪的请愿书征集到了3万个签名，对此政府回应称其“暂无计划禁止人造草坪的使用”。
gather.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

gather.sentenceEn: If you think other people are going to disagree, too, you might want to gather your army first.
gather.translationZh: 如果你认为其他人也会有不同意见，或许你应该先争取他们的支持。
gather.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

gather.sentenceEn: So keep it simple: "Hi", "Hey" or "Hello" – do the best you can to gather all of the enthusiasm and energy you can, put on a big smile and say "Hi".
gather.translationZh: 所以放轻松就好：说声“嗨”“嘿”或“你好”——尽你所能调动所有热情和活力，绽放一个灿烂的笑容，然后说“嗨”。
gather.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

generous.sentenceEn: And, as our research emphasizes, tipping now seems to be more coercive, less generous and often completely dissociated from service quality.
generous.translationZh: 而且，正如我们的研究所强调的，如今的小费似乎更具强制性，少了些慷慨，并且往往与服务质量完全脱节。
generous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

generous.sentenceEn: Instead, the claimant receives a time-limited "allowance," conditional on actively seeking a job; no entitlement and no insurance, at £71.70 a week, one of the least generous in the EU.
generous.translationZh: 取而代之的是，申领者获得的是有时间限制的"补贴"，条件是必须积极寻找工作；没有任何应得权益，也没有保险可言，每周仅71.70英镑，这是欧盟中最吝啬的福利之一。
generous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

generous.sentenceEn: Losing a job is hurting: you don't skip down to the jobcentre with a song in your heart, delighted at the prospect of doubling your income from the generous state.
generous.translationZh: 失业是件痛苦的事：你不会满心欢喜地蹦跳着去就业中心，也不会为能从慷慨的政府那里领到翻倍收入的前景而高兴。
generous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

generous.sentenceEn: Politicians have repeatedly "backloaded" public-sector pay deals, keeping the pay increases modest but adding to holidays and especially pensions that are already generous .
generous.translationZh: 政客们一再采用"后加载"的方式处理公共部门的薪酬协议，保持适度的薪资增长，却增加了假期，尤其是本已丰厚的养老金。
generous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

governance.sentenceEn: For example, a high growth rate placed great strains on the existing structures of governance , of administration, and above all of socialization.
governance.translationZh: 例如，高增长率给现有的治理结构、行政结构，尤其是社会化结构带来了巨大压力。
governance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

governance.sentenceEn: In the 1960s and 1970s, European universities saw marked changes in their governance arrangements, with empowerment of junior faculty and to some degree of students as well.
governance.translationZh: 在20世纪60年代和70年代，欧洲大学的治理结构发生了显著变化，青年教师获得了更多权力，学生在一定程度上也得到了赋权。
governance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

governance.sentenceEn: Yet it is principally during this period of stronger governance that CEO pay has been high and rising.
governance.translationZh: 然而，CEO薪酬居高不下且持续上涨的时期，主要正是在公司治理更为严格的这段时间。
governance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

governance.sentenceEn: By most measures, corporate governance has become a lot tighter and more rigorous since the 1970s.
governance.translationZh: 从大多数标准来看，自20世纪70年代以来，公司治理已变得更加严格和规范。
governance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

governance.sentenceEn: Good governance rests on an understanding of the inherent worth of each individual.
governance.translationZh: 善治的基础是理解每个人的内在价值。
governance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第5句

governance.sentenceEn: I don't like quotas either; they run counter to my belief in meritocracy, governance by the capable.
governance.translationZh: 我也不喜欢配额制；它与我对精英管理——即由有能力者治理——的信念相悖。
governance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

greatly.sentenceEn: As a result, these structures became important centres for cultural exchange and interaction, with travellers sharing their cultures, ideas and beliefs, as well as taking knowledge with them, greatly influencing the development of several civilisations.
greatly.translationZh: 因此，这些建筑成为了文化交流与互动的重要中心。旅行者们在此分享各自的文化、思想和信仰，同时也带走知识，这对多个文明的发展产生了深远影响。
greatly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

greatly.sentenceEn: Plant biology is complex and fascinating, but it differs so greatly from that of animals that so-called evidence of plants' intelligence is inconclusive, the authors wrote.
greatly.translationZh: 作者写道，植物生物学复杂而迷人，但其与动物生物学存在巨大差异，因此所谓植物拥有智能的证据并不确凿。
greatly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

greatly.sentenceEn: Also in the early 1900s, French sociologist Émile Durkheim developed a theory of culture that would greatly influence anthropology.
greatly.translationZh: 同样在20世纪初期，法国社会学家埃米尔·涂尔干提出了一种将对人类学产生深远影响的文化理论。
greatly.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
greatly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

greatly.sentenceEn: While the quality of legal journalism varies greatly , there is an undue reliance amongst many journalists on interpretations supplied to them by lawyers.
greatly.translationZh: 尽管法律新闻报道的质量参差不齐，但许多记者却过度依赖律师提供的解读。
greatly.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
greatly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

greatly.sentenceEn: Successful safety programs may differ greatly in the emphasis placed on certain aspects of the program.
greatly.translationZh: 成功的安全计划在侧重点上可能存在很大差异。
greatly.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）
greatly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

greatly.sentenceEn: They admitted that in the long run industrialization greatly raised the standard of living for the average man.
greatly.translationZh: 他们承认，从长远来看，工业化极大地提高了普通人的生活水平。
greatly.paperLabel: 考研英语 1998 英语（未分卷）
greatly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

guilty.sentenceEn: Yet as we report now, the food police are determined that this enjoyment should be rendered yet another guilty pleasure guaranteed to damage our health.
guilty.translationZh: 然而，正如我们现在所报道的，食品监管部门却决心要将这种享受也归为又一种必定损害健康的“罪恶快感”。
guilty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

guilty.sentenceEn: For the low-sympathy kids, how much they shared appeared to turn on how inclined they were to feel guilty .
guilty.translationZh: 对于那些同情心较低的孩子来说，他们分享巧克力币的多少似乎取决于他们感到内疚的倾向程度。
guilty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

guilty.sentenceEn: As the hacking trial concludes – finding guilty one ex-editor of the News of the World, Andy Coulson, for conspiring to hack phones, and finding his predecessor, Rebekah Brooks, innocent of the same charge – the wider issue of dearth of integrity still stands.
guilty.translationZh: 随着电话窃听案审理终结——《世界新闻报》前编辑安迪·库尔森因合谋窃听电话被判有罪，而其前任丽贝卡·布鲁克斯则被判无罪——但更为广泛的诚信缺失问题依然存在。
guilty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

guilty.sentenceEn: A variety of activities should be organized so that participants can remain active as long as they want and then go on to something else without feeling guilty and without letting the other participants down.
guilty.translationZh: 应当组织丰富多彩的活动，让参与者可以随心所欲地保持活跃状态，之后转做其他事情时也不会感到内疚，也不会让其他参与者失望。
guilty.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
guilty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

guilty.sentenceEn: Concerns were raised that witnesses might be encouraged to exaggerate their stories in court to ensure guilty verdicts.
guilty.translationZh: 人们担心，证人可能会被怂恿在法庭上夸大其词，以确保获得有罪判决。
guilty.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
guilty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

guilty.sentenceEn: Doctors will be held guilty if they risk their patients' death.
guilty.translationZh: 如果医生冒患者死亡的风险，他们将被判有罪。
guilty.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
